channel.title: Medics Musings: AI & Tech
channel.description: Satirical episodes about artificial intelligence in medicine: chatbots with opinions, algorithms that promise empathy, robots taking over the most intimate jobs, and doctors trying to keep up.

item.title: Out of Touch
item.description: Dr. Leo A. Gordon’s essay on the vanishing sense of touch in modern surgery, from the “tissue sense” of open operations to laparoscopy and robotic consoles. (10 min)

item.title: Out of Touch: From Healing Touch to Digital Distance
item.description: Written and read by Leo A. Gordon, MD, The American Bard of Medicine. Join a veteran surgeon's poignant and humorous journey through the evolution of modern surgery, where the intimate art of healing… (12 min)

item.title: Bedside Banter with Algo Chats-a-Lot III
item.description: Witty conversation with my AI Medical chatbot, Algo Chats-A-Lot,III, who offers opinions: What to prescribe for a computer virus. His version of "take two bytes and call me in the morning" Medical… (7 min)

item.title: AI Rounds: When Your Chatbot Assistant Bites Back!
item.description: Ever wondered what happens when an old-school doctor collides with cutting-edge AI? Join Dr. Davey Dinosaur (yes, that's what I'm calling myself now) as I navigate the fast-paced challenges of modern… (3 min)

item.title: Algorithms Meet Empathy: The Future of Patient Care
item.description: Artificial Intelligence is revolutionizing medicine, offering unprecedented accuracy in diagnosis and personalized treatment plans. But can it replace the human element? In this video, we explore how… (7 min)

item.title: Can Patients and Doctors Trust AI in Healthcare?
item.description: Can doctors and patients come to trust in and collaborate with AI in forming diagnoses and treatments? (Created with the help of Perplexity Pro AI) (11 min)

item.title: The Digital Doctor
item.description: Satirical take on AI in Healthcare. Is AI in Healthcare accurate enough to keep you safe and healthy? Is it an aid or impediment? Or both? (Created with the help of Perplexity Pro AI) (3 min)
